about_short_description.short_description: Keet develops software technology solution designed for vehicle fleet management.

product.name: 24/7 Real-Time Tracking
product.description: Provides continuous real-time GPS tracking of all fleet vehicles accessible via computer, tablet, or smartphone.

product.name: Archive
product.description: Stores historical driving data including routes, speed, and fuel usage for later review and analysis.

product.name: KeetSafe Protection
product.description: Monitors fleet vehicles for irregularities and violations, sending real-time alerts to managers via smartphone.

product.name: Custom Advice
product.description: Provides tailored recommendations based on fleet data to help reduce fuel consumption and improve driver performance.

product.name: Administrative Deadlines Management
product.description: Alerts fleet managers about upcoming administrative deadlines related to vehicles and drivers through notifications.

product.name: CO2 Footprint Compensation
product.description: Calculates the fleet’s carbon footprint and assists companies in certifying and compensating their environmental impact.
